title: No More Bedrock
description: Replaces the bedrock texture with deepslate. Top and sides use the correct deepslate textures. Lightweight, no extra files. Compatible with Java Edition 1.21.11.
body:
# No More Bedrock

No More Bedrock is a simple Minecraft resource pack that replaces the default bedrock texture with deepslate, creating a cleaner and more natural underground appearance.

The pack uses the correct deepslate textures for both the top and side faces, making bedrock blend seamlessly with the surrounding terrain. Perfect for players who prefer a more consistent mining and cave exploration experience.

## Features
- Replaces bedrock with deepslate
- Correct top and side textures
- Seamless underground appearance
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Clean and minimal style
- No unnecessary visual clutter

## Included Changes
- Bedrock → Deepslate texture replacement
- Matching top texture
- Matching side textures

## Installation
- Download the pack
- Move the ZIP file into your resourcepacks folder
- Enable the pack in Minecraft
- Load a world and enjoy the new look

## Notes
This pack only changes the visual appearance of bedrock. It does not affect gameplay, world generation or block properties.
